title: Add timing side-channel from deduplication to Security Considerations
description: Section 4 (blob probing) covers hash-based probing via FileNode access but misses the storage timing side-channel: if the server deduplicates blobs, an unusually fast upload response combined with the returned sha256 reveals that identical content is already stored. This is the proof-of-possession/storage side-channel attack. Add a sentence in Security Considerations.
close_reason: Added 'Upload Timing Side-Channel' subsection in Security Considerations after Blob Probing. Also added explicit {#blob-probing} anchor to enable the cross-reference.
